translation: Took place in posad Serock, 15 August 1890, 8 AM. Appeared personally Lejbka [unclear: Kejdzior], shoemaker, 54, and Berek Kołtun, laborer, 65, both residing in Serock, and declared that yesterday at 4 PM in posad Serock died Abram Hersz Sztatzinger, nine months of age, son of Chaim and Tauba. Upon eyewitness certification of the death of Abram Hersz Sztatzinger this act was read to the witnesses and signed by us; the witnesses are illiterate.
